eta_p>0, tau_m>0; every fixed finite latency and positive fixed cadence
basin: N(0)>0 and E(0)<Emax, with physical nonnegative bounded Z history; E(0)=0 and N(0)=K are allowed
excluded_boundary_faces: E(0)=Emax: effort remains Emax for continuous/native/exact nonlinear quota relaxation

consequences: global convergence to the unique positive protective equilibrium for every history in the stated basin
no nonconstant periodic or other non-equilibrium omega-limit set in that basin
